findings.claim: Immutable review-source provenance is stored as deferred work, so recovery exports it as a measurement obligation and causes an otherwise satisfied root acceptance check to fail for missing measurement identity.
findings.evidence: The binding producer writes kind:'deferred' with data:{reviewSource:{invocationId,base,head}}. coordinator.js:432-448 treats this as an actionable recoveryObligations entry; report-status:135-143 treats every non-runFailure deferred entry as a measurement, although this provenance record supplies none of sourceTree/command/configuration. This crosses the immutable-source metadata versus outstanding-work boundary. Independent frozen-source probe /tmp/ufz-pr2-controller/evidence-simplicity-design/probe.mjs executes the actual bind-review-source CLI, actual recovery reader and actual acceptance CLI. Receipt /tmp/ufz-pr2-controller/evidence-simplicity-design/receipt.json shows the synthetic satisfied control returns exit 0 / eligible:true; adding only the produced, recovered binding returns exit 3 / eligible:false with sole gap 'review-source:probe: measurement identity unavailable'. Other acceptance facts are synthetic controls; this is not a claim of actual run acceptance. This corroborates the additional final-review recovery/acceptance seam finding, absent from the embedded round-1 report. The binding must remain durable while being distinguished from measurement work.
